svg.title: Fuse compared with dotnet build and dotnet test (fuse.codes)
svg.desc: Fuse, a faster .NET build and test loop for AI coding agents (fuse.codes, github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse). Check an edit, fuse check against dotnet build. FluentValidation (4 projects): 0.34 seconds with Fuse, 2.13 seconds with dotnet, 6.2x faster at the median; Fuse 0.16 to 19.3 s, mean 1.19 s, P95 2.54 s; dotnet 1.52 to 9.61 s, mean 2.89 s, P95 8.17 s; NodaTime (15 projects): 1.13 seconds with Fuse, 2.95 seconds with dotnet, 2.6x faster at the median; Fuse 0.09 to 26.5 s, mean 2.63 s, P95 12.7 s; dotnet 1.72 to 10.7 s, mean 3.87 s, P95 7.56 s; Jellyfin (40 projects): 0.74 seconds with Fuse, 21.6 seconds with dotnet, 29.0x faster at the median; Fuse 0.13 to 78.0 s, mean 7.88 s, P95 56.9 s; dotnet 3.39 to 80.4 s, mean 25.8 s, P95 74.4 s; Polly (15 projects): 4.51 seconds with Fuse, 29.6 seconds with dotnet, 6.6x faster at the median; Fuse 1.37 to 44.6 s, mean 7.13 s, P95 22.7 s; dotnet 3.52 to 205.4 s, mean 44.1 s, P95 105.9 s. Run the affected tests, fuse test against dotnet test. FluentValidation (2,664 tests): 9.61 seconds with Fuse, 13.4 seconds with dotnet, 1.4x faster at the median; Fuse 7.71 to 44.9 s, mean 14.0 s, P95 44.9 s; dotnet 11.4 to 17.7 s, mean 14.0 s, P95 17.7 s; NodaTime (42,736 tests): 59.4 seconds with Fuse, 48.5 seconds with dotnet, 1.2x slower at the median; Fuse 0.14 to 106.7 s, mean 57.0 s, P95 106.7 s; dotnet 31.5 to 65.4 s, mean 48.3 s, P95 65.4 s; Jellyfin (2,535 tests): 107.3 seconds with Fuse, 160.4 seconds with dotnet, 1.5x faster at the median; Fuse 7.46 to 228.0 s, mean 114.4 s, P95 228.0 s; dotnet 139.9 to 182.8 s, mean 159.5 s, P95 182.8 s; Polly (12,329 tests): 46.1 seconds with Fuse, 109.1 seconds with dotnet, 2.4x faster at the median; Fuse 0.13 to 131.3 s, mean 43.9 s, P95 131.3 s; dotnet 92.8 to 123.8 s, mean 109.7 s, P95 123.8 s. Check on a warm engine, fuse check, P50 / P95 over the edits of each kind. FluentValidation: Body edit 239 / 312 ms, Signature edit 2,909 / 10,160 ms, Nothing changed, P50 31 ms; NodaTime: Body edit 820 / 1,044 ms, Signature edit 3,087 / 10,665 ms, Nothing changed, P50 45 ms; Jellyfin: Body edit 158 / 299 ms, Signature edit 138 / 51,290 ms, Nothing changed, P50 53 ms; Polly: Body edit 210 / 288 ms, Signature edit 819 / 43,835 ms, Nothing changed, P50 50 ms. Accuracy against the real build and test run, Counted against dotnet build and dotnet test on the same edits. FluentValidation: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 8 changes; NodaTime: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 7 changes; Jellyfin: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 2 changes; Polly: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 6 changes. Engine memory, Working set of the engine process. FluentValidation: After the checks 616 MB, Peak 624 MB, Idle 486 MB; NodaTime: After the checks 335 MB, Peak 601 MB, Idle 333 MB; Jellyfin: After the checks 494 MB, Peak 829 MB, Idle 493 MB; Polly: After the checks 688 MB, Peak 991 MB, Idle 613 MB. Swarm hypervisor and CLI, Zero-restore worktree check, brief check, and 20-request batch / 4-worktree RAM. FluentValidation: Zero-restore P50 3,149 ms, Brief check P50 424 ms, Batch / 4-wt RAM 84 ms / 364 MB; NodaTime: Zero-restore P50 4,816 ms, Brief check P50 201 ms, Batch / 4-wt RAM 369 ms / 649 MB; Jellyfin: Zero-restore P50 5,203 ms, Brief check P50 161 ms, Batch / 4-wt RAM 112 ms / 730 MB; Polly: Zero-restore P50 4,755 ms, Brief check P50 172 ms, Batch / 4-wt RAM 212 ms / 671 MB. Median times over the eval cases, each with the range from the fastest to the slowest case, the mean and P95, on GitHub Actions windows-latest runners.
